claims: Chipotle is offering a Buy-One-Get-One (BOGO) free entrée deal on Friday, March 13, 2026, from 3 p.m. to 4 p.m. local time
The deal is to customers who show a tattoo (real, temporary, or drawn)
The "Tatted Like a Chipotle Bag" promotion is valid in-store only at participating locations in the U.S. and Canada
The deal is on Friday, March 13, 2026, from 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM local time
Show a tattoo (real, fake, or drawn on) to the cashier when ordering to get the deal
Buy one entrée (burrito, bowl, salad, or taco order) and get a second of equal or lesser value for free
The promotion is at participating U.S. and Canada locations, in-restaurant only
The promotion is not valid online, for mobile ordering, or for catering
Limit is up to 5 free items per check
The deal is a nod to the "Tatted Like a Chipotle Bag" meme inspired by the doodles on Chipotle's bags
The deal has been run in previous years on Friday the 13th, per this article from The Columbus Dispatch
